releaseNotes:
- Added intelligent Screen Capture Engine selection (Auto, DXGI, BitBlt) to the Settings Menu
- Implemented smart hardware heuristics to automatically assign the optimal capture method for legacy GPUs
- Completely overhauled the Settings UI with a custom sleek, dark-themed layout
- Added a toggle for the Debug Logger Console within settings
- Fixed a significant delay when opening the font dropdown menu
- Fixed Quick Save icon color not properly adapting to Light Mode
- General bug fixes and stability improvements
